title: Artfully Arranged Slovakian Vegetable Muffins
description: Earthly and tender, these Slovakian vegetable muffins are a show-off dish featuring sashimi-cut vegetables, perfect for a vegetarian-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the grated carrot, grated zucchini, chopped scallions, and shredded cheese.
Add the egg, milk, and olive oil to the bowl with the vegetables and stir until combined.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until just combined.
Divide the batter evenly among 12 muffin cups.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the muffins are golden brown.
Allow the muffins to cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then transfer them to a wire rack to cool completely.
Slice the muffins in half and arrange on a tagliere with sashimi-cut vegetables.
